<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Ahnaf Hawlader — Materials Engineering</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:opsz,wght@9..144,400..700&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root {
    --bg: #F6FAFD;
    --bg-alt: #FCF1F6;
    --bg-panel: #FFFFFF;
    --cream: #33324A;
    --cream-dim: #6E7291;
    --marigold: #F49FC6;
    --coral: #FF87B0;
    --teal: #6FC3E8;
    --pink-ink: #C43F82;
    --blue-ink: #2C8FC2;
    --line: rgba(51,50,74,0.10);
    --dot-color: rgba(111,195,232,0.22);
    --nav-bg: rgba(246,250,253,0.86);
    --pill-bg: rgba(51,50,74,0.045);
    --subtle-fill: rgba(51,50,74,0.04);
    --btn-ink: #402244;
    --btn-shadow: rgba(244,159,198,0.45);
    --icon-bg: rgba(111,195,232,0.18);
    --tag-bg: rgba(244,159,198,0.22);
    --radius-blob: 62% 38% 37% 63% / 58% 41% 59% 42%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px);
    padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px);
  }

  /* ---- Dark theme ---- */
  :root[data-theme="dark"] {
    --bg: #1B1830;
    --bg-alt: #241D38;
    --bg-panel: #2A2240;
    --cream: #F3EFFB;
    --cream-dim: #B6AECF;
    --marigold: #F49FC6;
    --coral: #FF8CB4;
    --teal: #7BD1F5;
    --pink-ink: #FF9FCE;
    --blue-ink: #7FD3FA;
    --line: rgba(243,239,251,0.14);
    --dot-color: rgba(123,209,245,0.16);
    --nav-bg: rgba(27,24,48,0.86);
    --pill-bg: rgba(243,239,251,0.06);
    --subtle-fill: rgba(243,239,251,0.055);
    --btn-ink: #2E1330;
    --btn-shadow: rgba(244,159,198,0.25);
    --icon-bg: rgba(123,209,245,0.16);
    --tag-bg: rgba(244,159,198,0.16);
  }
  @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    :root:not([data-theme="light"]) {
      --bg: #1B1830;
      --bg-alt: #241D38;
      --bg-panel: #2A2240;
      --cream: #F3EFFB;
      --cream-dim: #B6AECF;
      --marigold: #F49FC6;
      --coral: #FF8CB4;
      --teal: #7BD1F5;
      --pink-ink: #FF9FCE;
      --blue-ink: #7FD3FA;
      --line: rgba(243,239,251,0.14);
      --dot-color: rgba(123,209,245,0.16);
      --nav-bg: rgba(27,24,48,0.86);
      --pill-bg: rgba(243,239,251,0.06);
      --subtle-fill: rgba(243,239,251,0.055);
      --btn-ink: #2E1330;
      --btn-shadow: rgba(244,159,198,0.25);
      --icon-bg: rgba(123,209,245,0.16);
      --tag-bg: rgba(244,159,198,0.16);
    }
  }

  body { transition: background 0.25s ease, color 0.25s ease; }
  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: inherit; }
  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; scroll-padding-top: calc(72px + env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px)); }
  html, body { height: auto; }

  body {
    margin: 0;
    background: var(--bg);
    color: var(--cream);
    font-family: 'Space Grotesk', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
    line-height: 1.55;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    * { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; }
  }

  a { color: inherit; }

  h1, h2, h3 {
    font-family: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif;
    font-weight: 500;
    margin: 0;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  }

  .wrap {
    max-width: 1080px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 0 28px;
  }

  /* decorative dot texture */
  .dots {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background-image: radial-gradient(circle, var(--dot-color) 1.4px, transparent 1.4px);
    background-size: 22px 22px;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  /* ---------- NAV ---------- */
  header.nav {
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 50;
    padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px);
    background: var(--nav-bg);
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .nav-inner {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 16px 28px;
    max-width: 1080px;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }
  .nav-name {
    font-family: 'Fraunces', serif;
    font-size: 1.05rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-decoration: none;
    color: var(--cream);
  }
  .nav-links {
    display: flex;
    gap: 26px;
    list-style: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
  }
  .nav-links a {
    text-decoration: none;
    font-size: 0.92rem;
    color: var(--cream-dim);
    transition: color 0.2s ease;
  }
  .nav-links a:hover, .nav-links a:focus-visible { color: var(--pink-ink); }
  .nav-links { display: none; }
  @media (min-width: 720px) { .nav-links { display: flex; } }

  .nav-right {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 20px;
  }
  .theme-toggle {
    position: relative;
    width: 38px;
    height: 38px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    background: var(--pill-bg);
    color: var(--cream);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0;
    transition: border-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease;
  }
  .theme-toggle:hover { border-color: var(--teal); color: var(--blue-ink); }
  .theme-toggle .icon-moon { display: none; }
  :root[data-theme="dark"] .theme-toggle .icon-sun { display: none; }
  :root[data-theme="dark"] .theme-toggle .icon-moon { display: block; }
  @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    :root:not([data-theme="light"]) .theme-toggle .icon-sun { display: none; }
    :root:not([data-theme="light"]) .theme-toggle .icon-moon { display: block; }
  }

  /* ---------- HERO ---------- */
  .hero {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    padding: 64px 0 80px;
  }
  .hero-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 44px;
    align-items: center;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
  }
  @media (min-width: 860px) {
    .hero-grid { grid-template-columns: 1.15fr 0.85fr; gap: 24px; }
  }
  .eyebrow-line {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    color: var(--pink-ink);
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    margin-bottom: 18px;
  }
  .eyebrow-line svg { flex-shrink: 0; }
  .hero h1 {
    font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4.1rem);
    line-height: 1.05;
    color: var(--cream);
  }
  .hero h1 em {
    font-style: italic;
    color: var(--pink-ink);
  }
  .hero-sub {
    margin-top: 20px;
    font-size: 1.15rem;
    color: var(--cream-dim);
    max-width: 46ch;
  }
  .hero-meta {
    margin-top: 26px;
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 10px;
  }
  .pill {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    padding: 7px 14px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: var(--cream-dim);
    background: var(--pill-bg);
  }
  .hero-cta {
    margin-top: 34px;
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 14px;
  }
  .btn {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 13px 22px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    transition: transform 0.18s ease, box-shadow 0.18s ease;
    border: 1px solid transparent;
  }
  .btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); }
  .btn-primary {
    background: var(--marigold);
    color: var(--btn-ink);
  }
  .btn-primary:hover { box-shadow: 0 10px 24px var(--btn-shadow); }
  .btn-ghost {
    border-color: var(--line);
    color: var(--cream);
  }
  .btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--teal); color: var(--blue-ink); }

  .photo-frame {
    position: relative;
    justify-self: center;
    width: min(340px, 78vw);
  }
  .blob-bg {
    position: absolute;
    inset: -18px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--coral), var(--marigold));
    border-radius: var(--radius-blob);
    animation: morph 14s ease-in-out infinite;
    opacity: 0.9;
    z-index: 0;
  }
  .photo-frame img {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    width: 100%;
    display: block;
    object-fit: cover;
    aspect-ratio: 3/4;
    border-radius: var(--radius-blob);
    animation: morph 14s ease-in-out infinite;
    border: 4px solid var(--bg);
  }
  @keyframes morph {
    0%, 100% { border-radius: 62% 38% 37% 63% / 58% 41% 59% 42%; }
    33% { border-radius: 45% 55% 62% 38% / 40% 62% 38% 60%; }
    66% { border-radius: 55% 45% 40% 60% / 55% 35% 65% 45%; }
  }

  /* ---------- SECTION SHARED ---------- */
  section { position: relative; padding: 76px 0; }
  .section-alt { background: var(--bg-alt); }
  .kicker {
    color: var(--blue-ink);
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    display: block;
  }
  .section-head {
    max-width: 640px;
    margin-bottom: 44px;
  }
  .section-head h2 {
    font-size: clamp(1.7rem, 3.4vw, 2.4rem);
    color: var(--cream);
  }
  .section-head p { color: var(--cream-dim); margin-top: 12px; font-size: 1.02rem; }

  /* ---------- ABOUT ---------- */
  .about-body {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 30px;
  }
  @media (min-width: 780px) {
    .about-body { grid-template-columns: 1.3fr 1fr; }
  }
  .about-body p {
    font-size: 1.08rem;
    color: var(--cream-dim);
    margin: 0 0 18px;
  }
  .about-body p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
  .about-card {
    background: var(--bg-panel);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 20px;
    padding: 26px;
    align-self: start;
  }
  .about-card h3 {
    font-size: 1.05rem;
    color: var(--pink-ink);
    margin-bottom: 14px;
  }
  .about-card ul { margin: 0; padding-left: 18px; color: var(--cream-dim); font-size: 0.95rem; }
  .about-card li { margin-bottom: 8px; }
  .about-card li:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

  /* ---------- PROJECTS ---------- */
  .project-list {
    display: grid;
    gap: 20px;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  @media (min-width: 780px) {
    .project-list { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
  }
  .project-card {
    background: var(--bg-panel);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 20px;
    padding: 28px 24px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 14px;
    transition: border-color 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease;
  }
  .project-card:hover { border-color: var(--teal); transform: translateY(-4px); }
  .project-icon {
    width: 42px; height: 42px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    background: var(--icon-bg);
    color: var(--blue-ink);
  }
  .project-card h3 { font-size: 1.15rem; color: var(--cream); }
  .project-meta { font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--cream-dim); opacity: 0.85; }
  .project-card p { color: var(--cream-dim); font-size: 0.95rem; margin: 0; flex-grow: 1; }
  .tag-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin-top: 4px; }
  .tag {
    font-size: 0.76rem;
    padding: 4px 10px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--tag-bg);
    color: var(--pink-ink);
  }

  /* ---------- TIMELINE ---------- */
  .timeline {
    position: relative;
    padding-left: 28px;
    border-left: 2px solid var(--line);
  }
  .t-item {
    position: relative;
    padding-bottom: 34px;
  }
  .t-item:last-child { padding-bottom: 0; }
  .t-item::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    left: -34px;
    top: 4px;
    width: 12px;
    height: 12px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--coral);
    border: 3px solid var(--bg);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--coral);
  }
  .t-date { font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--blue-ink); margin-bottom: 4px; }
  .t-item h3 { font-size: 1.08rem; color: var(--cream); margin-bottom: 2px; }
  .t-org { font-size: 0.92rem; color: var(--cream-dim); margin-bottom: 8px; display: block; }
  .t-item p { margin: 0; color: var(--cream-dim); font-size: 0.94rem; }
  .timeline-note {
    margin-top: 30px;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    color: var(--cream-dim);
  }
  .timeline-note a { color: var(--blue-ink); text-decoration: underline; }

  /* ---------- SKILLS ---------- */
  .skills-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 22px;
  }
  @media (min-width: 780px) {
    .skills-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
  }
  .skill-group {
    background: var(--bg-panel);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 20px;
    padding: 24px;
  }
  .skill-group h3 {
    font-size: 1rem;
    color: var(--blue-ink);
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }
  .skill-pills { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }
  .skill-pill {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    padding: 7px 13px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: var(--subtle-fill);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    color: var(--cream);
  }

  /* ---------- EDUCATION / HONORS ---------- */
  .edu-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 24px;
  }
  @media (min-width: 780px) {
    .edu-grid { grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1fr; }
  }
  .edu-card {
    background: var(--bg-panel);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 20px;
    padding: 26px;
    margin-bottom: 18px;
  }
  .edu-card:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
  .edu-card h3 { font-size: 1.1rem; color: var(--cream); }
  .edu-when { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--blue-ink); margin: 4px 0 10px; }
  .edu-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--cream-dim); font-size: 0.93rem; }
  .honor-list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
  .honor-list li {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
    padding: 10px 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    font-size: 0.93rem;
    color: var(--cream-dim);
  }
  .honor-list li:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
  .honor-list svg { flex-shrink: 0; color: var(--pink-ink); }

  /* ---------- CONTACT ---------- */
  .contact-panel {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--bg-panel), var(--bg-alt));
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 26px;
    padding: 52px 40px;
    text-align: center;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .contact-panel h2 { font-size: clamp(1.7rem, 4vw, 2.3rem); }
  .contact-panel p { color: var(--cream-dim); margin: 14px auto 30px; max-width: 46ch; }
  .contact-cta { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; gap: 14px; }
  .resume-note {
    margin-top: 22px;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: var(--cream-dim);
    opacity: 0.75;
  }

  footer {
    padding: 30px 0 calc(30px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    color: var(--cream-dim);
    opacity: 0.7;
  }

  ::selection { background: var(--marigold); color: var(--btn-ink); }

  :focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--teal);
    outline-offset: 3px;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header class="nav">
  <div class="nav-inner">
    <a href="#top" class="nav-name">Ahnaf Hawlader</a>
    <div class="nav-right">
      <ul class="nav-links">
        <li><a href="#about">About</a></li>
        <li><a href="#projects">Projects</a></li>
        <li><a href="#experience">Experience</a></li>
        <li><a href="#skills">Skills</a></li>
        <li><a href="#education">Education</a></li>
        <li><a href="#contact">Contact</a></li>
      </ul>
      <button id="themeToggle" class="theme-toggle" type="button" aria-label="Switch to dark mode" aria-pressed="false">
        <svg class="icon-sun" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4.5" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"/><path d="M12 2.5v2.4M12 19.1v2.4M4.2 4.2l1.7 1.7M18.1 18.1l1.7 1.7M2.5 12h2.4M19.1 12h2.4M4.2 19.8l1.7-1.7M18.1 5.9l1.7-1.7" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
        <svg class="icon-moon" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><path d="M20 14.3A8.5 8.5 0 1 1 9.7 4a6.7 6.7 0 0 0 10.3 10.3z" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>
</header>

<main id="top">

  <section class="hero">
    <div class="dots" aria-hidden="true"></div>
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="hero-grid">
        <div>
          <span class="eyebrow-line">
            <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"/><path d="M12 3v18M3 12h18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.2" opacity="0.5"/></svg>
            Materials Engineering, University of Toronto
          </span>
          <h1>Building toward better<br><em>prosthetics</em> &amp; implants.</h1>
          <p class="hero-sub">Ahnaf Hawlader — third-year engineering student specializing in biomaterials, with a minor in bioengineering and a habit of leading whatever room he's in.</p>
          <div class="hero-meta">
            <span class="pill">Class of 2T9 + PEY</span>
            <span class="pill">Biomaterials theme</span>
            <span class="pill">Bioengineering minor</span>
          </div>
          <div class="hero-cta">
            <a class="btn btn-primary" href="mailto:ahnaf.hawlader@mail.utoronto.ca">Email me</a>
            <a class="btn btn-ghost" href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/ahnaf0/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">View LinkedIn</a>
            <button class="btn btn-ghost" id="resumeBtnHero" type="button" hidden>Download resume</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="photo-frame">
          <div class="blob-bg" aria-hidden="true"></div>
          <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Portrait of Ahnaf Hawlader outdoors in a garden">
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="about">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="section-head">
        <span class="kicker">About</span>
        <h2>Engineering with a specific destination in mind</h2>
      </div>
      <div class="about-body">
        <div>
          <p>I'm a third-year Engineering student at the University of Toronto, specializing in the Biomaterials theme and pursuing a minor in Bioengineering. I'm driven by a strong pull toward biomaterials specifically — I want to use my degree to make real contributions to prosthetics and medical device implants, and most of what I choose to work on is pointed in that direction.</p>
          <p>The bioengineering minor is deliberate too: it's my pathway into biomedical research, and I'm currently enrolled in PEY Co-op to get real industry experience before I graduate.</p>
          <p>Outside coursework, I care about making the spaces I'm part of more welcoming — through EDI work, mentoring, and taking on leadership roles across campus. I'd describe myself as someone who leads with curiosity, follows through, and works well with people from a lot of different backgrounds.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="about-card">
          <h3>Quick facts</h3>
          <ul>
            <li>Based in Toronto &amp; Oshawa, Ontario</li>
            <li>Bachelor of Applied Science, Engineering — 2024–2029</li>
            <li>Enrolled in the PEY Co-Op Program</li>
            <li>Coursework: Engineering Biology, Intro to Biomaterials, Mechanical Behaviour of Materials, Organic Materials Chemistry, Materials Physics</li>
            <li>SOLIDWORKS Additive Manufacturing Associate</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="projects" class="section-alt">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="section-head">
        <span class="kicker">Selected projects</span>
        <h2>Hands-on work in design, research &amp; testing</h2>
        <p>A few things I've built, researched, or led on project teams.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="project-list">

        <div class="project-card">
          <div class="project-icon">
            <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><path d="M12 2v6M12 16v6M4.9 4.9l4.2 4.2M14.9 14.9l4.2 4.2M2 12h6M16 12h6M4.9 19.1l4.2-4.2M14.9 9.1l4.2-4.2" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
          </div>
          <h3>Biomedical toolkit</h3>

<script>
(function () {
  var root = document.documentElement;
  var toggleBtn;

  function getStored() {
    try {
      return localStorage.getItem('ahnaf-theme');
    } catch (e) {
      return null;
    }
  }
  function setStored(value) {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('ahnaf-theme', value);
    } catch (e) {
      /* storage unavailable; theme just won't persist */
    }
  }
  function systemPrefersDark() {
    return window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
  }
  function isDarkActive() {
    var stored = getStored();
    if (stored === 'dark') return true;
    if (stored === 'light') return false;
    return systemPrefersDark();
  }
  function applyToggleState() {
    if (!toggleBtn) return;
    var dark = isDarkActive();
    toggleBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', dark ? 'true' : 'false');
    toggleBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', dark ? 'Switch to light mode' : 'Switch to dark mode');
  }

  var stored = getStored();
  if (stored === 'dark' || stored === 'light') {
    root.setAttribute('data-theme', stored);
  }

  window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    toggleBtn = document.getElementById('themeToggle');
    applyToggleState();
    if (toggleBtn) {
      toggleBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var nextDark = !isDarkActive();
        var nextTheme = nextDark ? 'dark' : 'light';
        root.setAttribute('data-theme', nextTheme);
        setStored(nextTheme);
        applyToggleState();
      });
    }
  });
})();
</script>
<script>
(function () {
  var RESUME_BASE64 = "";
  var RESUME_FILENAME = "Ahnaf_Hawlader_Resume.pdf";

  function base64ToBlob(base64, mimeType) {
    var byteChars = atob(base64);
    var byteNumbers = new Array(byteChars.length);
    for (var i = 0; i < byteChars.length; i++) {
      byteNumbers[i] = byteChars.charCodeAt(i);
    }
    return new Blob([new Uint8Array(byteNumbers)], { type: mimeType });
  }

  async function trySave(btn) {
    if (!btn || !window.claude) return;
    try {
      var downloads = await window.claude.use("downloads");
      if (!downloads) return;
      btn.hidden = false;
      btn.addEventListener("click", async function () {
        try {
          var blob = base64ToBlob(RESUME_BASE64, "application/pdf");
          await downloads.save({ filename: RESUME_FILENAME, data: blob });
        } catch (err) {
          console.error("Resume download failed:", err);
        }
      });
    } catch (err) {
      // capability unavailable in this view; leave the buttons hidden
    }
  }

  window.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    trySave(document.getElementById("resumeBtnHero"));
    trySave(document.getElementById("resumeBtnContact"));
  });
})();
</script>
